text:
equals
Description
Tests if one string equals another string.
Syntax
<
string1
>
equals
<
string2
>
<string1> equals <string2>
Tests if string1 equals string2.
Examples
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
if
{
[
HTTP
::
uri
]
equals
"/login"
}
{
pool
login_pool
}
else
{
pool
default_pool
}
}
when CLIENT_ACCEPTED {
   if { class match [IP::client_addr] equals aol] } {
      pool aol_pool
   } else {
      pool all_pool
   }
}
